name: East Baton Rouge Parish, LA
findings: East Baton Rouge Parish has 2,082 nonprofit organizations. 838 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 700 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, East Baton Rouge Parish has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Professional organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 74 professional organizations here list membership, compared with about 26 in similar places of this size.
